classificationRules.protectedChange: If an upstream candidate changes, deletes, or renames any protected path, omit that path from the fusion patch and preserve the current Nova tree. Record the path in preservedProtectedPaths.
classificationRules.conflictChange: Only a real three-way conflict in an unprotected path blocks the candidate and requires manual resolution.
classificationRules.versionChange: FORK_VERSION and backend/cmd/server/VERSION remain Nova-controlled metadata and are updated by update_nova_versions() after the filtered patch is applied.
classificationRules.unlistedChange: Changes outside protected paths use the normal validation and automatic merge policy after all required checks pass.

validationRequirements: frontend lint, typecheck, tests, and build
Nova Docker Compose build, startup, and health smoke checks
